request.style: English, male baritone solo with choir, acoustic piano, cello, organ, timpani, somber and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the fifth month of that year
The prophet Hananiah stood
In the house of the LORD
Before the priests and crowd
He spoke in the name of God
That Babylon's rule would cease
And vessels would return
From the distant Babylon

[Verse]
He would bring back Jeconiah
And all the exiles home
Within two years he said
The yoke would be undone
Jeremiah replied Amen
May the LORD do so
But listen to my word
To you and to the crowd

[Verse]
Prophets long before your time
Spoke of war and plague
But he who prophesies peace
Must see it come to pass
Then Hananiah took the yoke
From the prophet's neck
He broke it in pieces
Before the eyes of all

[Verse]
He declared to the people
That God had spoken
That within two years
He'd break the yoke off
Jeremiah went his way
But the word came to him
You broke yokes of wood
Yet you made yokes of iron

[Verse]
The LORD of hosts has put
An iron yoke on them
To serve Nebuchadnezzar
And serve him they will
The wild animals given
To the king of Babylon
You have made them trust
In a great and heavy lie

[Outro]
Hananiah died in the seventh month
In that very same year
